effect:
Raises Sp.Def on a special hit.

Maranga Berry activates when your Pokémon takes a special hit, giving a +1 Special Defense boost. It's the special counterpart to Kee Berry!

This is useful for physical attackers or tanks that worry about special attacks. If you know you're going into a special attacker but need to survive a hit to do your job, Maranga Berry can provide that cushion. Consumed after use, like other berries.
